import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { users } from "./users";
import { notes } from "./notes";

// Introspected as an owned-child: belongs to notes (its only NOT NULL foreign key) and nothing else references it.
export const noteComments = defineTable("note_comments", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial().primaryKey(),
        noteId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        visible: col.boolean().notNull(),
        createdAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone").notNull(),
        authorIp: col.custom("inet"),
        authorId: col.bigint(),
        body: col.text(),
        event: col.enum(["opened", "closed", "reopened", "commented", "hidden"], { name: "note_event_enum" })
    },
    relations: {
        author: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        note: rel.belongsTo(() => notes, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
